meta.title: A Postcard from the Nature Park

paragraphs: On Saturday, the Explorers went to the nature park for their club trip. Teacher Kim counted the children before they left. It was a foggy morning, and the bus drove slowly. After the trip, Mia bought a postcard at the park shop. It had a picture of the lake on the front. She wrote to her pen pal Nadia on the bus. "Dear Nadia, Hello from the nature park!

This morning, there was a lot of fog. The air was cold and wet. For Leo, it was like a walk in a cloud. We could not see the lake or the trees. Ranger Mark told us this: the fog goes away when the sun comes up. We walked slowly in a line, and each child held a small green flag. Next, we walked to the lake. Ranger Mark let each of us touch a tortoise shell. It was hard and cold.

After lunch, the weather changed. A storm came, and the rain was very loud. We ran to the park house and waited there. The house was small, but it was warm and dry. The thunder was loud, and Leo put his hands on his ears. We ate rice and fruit while the storm made a lot of noise. May loved it, and she smiled all the time. After one hour, the storm stopped, and the sun came out.

Next, we saw a rainbow over the lake. I took six photos of it. It had red, orange, yellow, green, and blue colors. I will send you one photo by email. I have never seen such a big rainbow before. The park is open every day, and it is a lovely place. We took the bus home at three o'clock.
Do you have foggy days in Singapore? What do you do when there is a storm? Write to me soon. Your friend, Mia"
text.summary: Mia writes a postcard to her pen pal Nadia after the Explorers' trip to the nature park. She tells about the foggy morning, the tortoise shell, the storm after lunch, and a rainbow.

images.prompt: A group of children walk in a line along a path by a lake in thick white fog. Each child holds a small green flag with a paw print. Ranger Mark, a man of about forty with short black hair under a green cap, a khaki shirt with two chest pockets, green trousers, and brown boots, walks in front.
images.caption: The Explorers walk in the fog.

images.caption: The children wait for the storm to stop.
